decisions.reason: The source refines the Hero V but does not yet specify a changed accent construction; the existing rule that the accent derives from the Hero V remains valid unchanged.
The source postpones development of the second V until the Hero V is resolved and does not establish a new second-V geometry; its existing derivation rule remains unchanged.
The source focuses on Hero V arm construction and leaves the already deferred supporting E and L letterforms unchanged.
The source contrasts geometry with decorative styling but neither changes nor resumes the deferred champagne material treatment.
The source does not change the kerning goal and leaves full-wordmark development, including the deferred kerning work, for after the Hero V is resolved.
The Hero V refinements do not alter the established hierarchy in which the closing V remains smaller and subordinate.
